title: 2 of My Most Recent Projects with 0 Coding Knowledge
author: Shoddy-Topic-3228
selftext:
You guys asked for the type of projects I am making with 0 coding knowledge. Here are 2 I just started working on Wednesday. So fun to make, multiplayer working on both as well. 

Last post, everyone said the projects were terrible without seeing them. I feel like I have great base games and for making these both within a busy last 48 hours due to Thanksgiving. I am pretty pleased. Which style of roguelike do you like?

https://youtu.be/aRbj1DZS8lI

comments.author: meiklety
comments.body:
Wow! I think it’s a great base as well. And crazy what someone with zero background can create in 48 hours with ai. 

Mind sharing the main tools you are using?

replies.author: Shoddy-Topic-3228
replies.body: Claude. People just don't seem to know how to prompt well. I spent lots of time learning how to best use AI. Now under about 45 to 60 minutes I can actually have a base game of almost any kind.

replies.author: meiklety
replies.body: Nice! And what program are you using to build the game? Sorry, I’m pretty novice as well!

replies.author: Many_Brush_9176
replies.body: Great stuff. Do you mind sharing the learning content you used to get good at prompting?

replies.author: TallonZek
replies.body: I just posted my prototype, a lot of peoples opinions seem to be at least 6 months behind, they are getting really good at coding.

comments.author: SanFranLocal
comments.body:
I’m a programmer. I rarely have to write code anymore as I’m developing into game development which is really nice.

However you are not at that point where the game will start breaking. It’s not how you prompt it. It’s about you keeping a mental model of the codebase in your head reviewing what Claude comes up with. Programming is iterative so you’re going to be adding/removing code and Claude will mess up. Then you will be stuck

replies.author: Shoddy-Topic-3228
replies.body: I have a base. I have prompts that ensure this doesnt happen. I have released now a full game on steam and its done fairly well.

replies.author: SanFranLocal
replies.body: It’s definitely not a complicated game I can tell you that

replies.author: coverednmud
replies.body: Great job, ignore the negative comments.

comments.author: Jewish_Coin
comments.body: Try to finish one and report back soldier
